# openwebui_openai_connection_verify (Data Source)

Verifies that an OpenAI-compatible endpoint is reachable and accepts the provided credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Base URL to verify, e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`.

### Optional

- `api_provider` (String) Provider hint, e.g. `azure`. Passed to Open WebUI's verification logic.
- `api_version` (String) Azure API version, e.g. `2024-02-01`. Used when `api_provider = "azure"`.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method, e.g. `bearer`. Passed to Open WebUI's verification logic.
- `headers_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of custom headers to include in the verification request.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key or bearer token. Sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `verified` (Boolean) `true` if Open WebUI successfully connected to the endpoint.
